purpose: Every five minutes, read Magic Context's finished subagent invocations through ck-mc's read-only op and wake MC when a new failure class appears, a task's failure share reaches 25% over at least 8 runs in 24 hours, or a failure class doubles against the preceding 24 hours. Quota failures recovered by a completed fallback are not counted, and a repeat alert is held for 6 hours unless its count grows by half.
